description: Consumer mobile phone plans (SIM-only and prepaid) in these markets: Belgium, Netherlands, Luxembourg, France, Iceland, Hungary, Finland, Slovenia, Ireland, Slovakia, Estonia, Latvia, Croatia, Greece, Malta, Liechtenstein, Portugal, Lithuania, Romania, Bulgaria, Cyprus, Czechia, Norway, Sweden, Austria, Poland, Italy, Denmark, United Kingdom, Switzerland, Spain, Germany, United States, Canada, including mobile data while travelling from there. Returns the plans that meet every stated need, ranked by effective monthly cost including promos, one-off fees and the cost of covering their trips (EU allowance and surcharges, or Canada and Mexico for US plans; operator roaming passes, travel eSIMs), each with its source link and check date (collected_by_hand where a person read the price on the operator's own website), plus questions worth asking the person (missing_inputs).

accept_contract.description: false = only plans without a minimum contract. Prepaid packs paid several months up front are not contracts (each result says so); use max_term_months to limit them.

age.description: Only needed for youth and senior plans.

autopay.description: false = the person won't use AutoPay; advertised AutoPay discounts are added back. Default true.

country.description: Market, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (BE, NL, LU, FR, IS, HU, FI, SI, IE, SK, EE, LV, HR, GR, MT, LI, PT, LT, RO, BG, CY, CZ, NO, SE, AT, PL, IT, DK, GB, CH, ES, DE, US, CA). Prices are in that market's currency.

data_gb_month.description: Mobile data the person uses per month, in GB, or "unlimited".

has_home_internet_with.description: Operator group the person has home internet with (e.g. Proximus, Orange or Telenet in Belgium), which unlocks bundle prices.

horizon_months.description: Months to average costs over, including promos. Default 12.

hotspot_gb_month.description: Mobile hotspot (tethering) data needed per month, in GB. Plans that don't state enough hotspot data don't fit.

lines.description: Number of lines (e.g. a family of 4). Default 1. Costs are then the total for all lines; each line has the data/minutes need above.

max_monthly_eur.description: Budget per month in the market's currency (despite the name), as advertised; for all lines together.

max_term_months.description: Longest term the person accepts, in months: a contract or months paid up front (e.g. an annual prepaid pack). 1 = month to month only; 12, 24, 36… Omit for any.

minutes_month.description: Minutes of calls a month you need; null = unlimited. Omit or 0 if you don't need calls.

province.description: Canada: the province or territory (name or code, e.g. Quebec, ON) where the line will be used. Plans whose source lists other provinces don't fit.

roaming_gb_month.description: Optional EU roaming need in GB per month; omit if unknown.

sms_month.description: National SMS per month; null = unlimited. Default 0. Plans that charge per SMS beyond their allowance are costed at the stated rate, so a rough figure is fine.

special_eligibility.description: True if the person qualifies for offers limited to some customers (students, social tariffs, porting from a named operator, existing customers of another service). Default false: such plans are listed as not fitting, with the condition.

travel.description: Specific trips per year, when the person knows them. Takes precedence over travel_profile and roaming_gb_month. Omit all three if unknown (the result then lists travel under missing_inputs); pass [] if the person does not travel. A trip with both days_per_year and data_gb_per_day is costed exactly; a trip missing either (e.g. just the country) only requires the plan to offer roaming there — no size or cost is assumed.

country.description: Destination, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. FR, US, MA).

data_gb_per_day.description: Omit if unknown; don't guess it, since omitting it changes how the trip is ranked (see travel's description).

travel_profile.description: How the person travels, when they describe it loosely: eu_occasional or eu_frequent = EU travel with no stated amount. Only requires the plan to offer EU roaming; no trip size or cost is assumed. Give roaming_gb_month, or travel with days_per_year and data_gb_per_day, to cost a specific amount instead.

travels_outside_eu.description: True if the person sometimes travels outside the EU. Each result then lists the plan's own options there (passes, included countries, pay-per-use rate) without costing a specific trip.
